digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command, rebar-janitor Discovery phase, project documentation
propositions: rebar-janitor Discovery phase must consult rebar metrics historical output (with --since/--until --output json) to cite code-health lens trend evidence during assessment
documentation must make the rebar metrics command, its four metric lenses, source/confidence labels, and unavailable state discoverable to agents and contributors
docs must explicitly document the unavailable state and distinguish between accruing metrics versus authoritative structural series
the reusable rebar.metrics registry subsystem (MetricSpec/REGISTRY) must be discoverable for library consumers
AGENTS.md must include a Metrics navigation pointer to user-guide and reuse-surface docs
